title: Matemágico · sus figuras
description: docs/animas/matemagico/README.md § How each skill looks (Aitor's notes on the ánimas' sheet, 2026-11-21): each skill of his tree past Foc Binari is a figure drawn in his circle that then does what it is (src/math-figures.ts). In the fight tester against three sturdy dogs, one player leading both; Aitor holds on between them. Run it with --gpu.

steps.eval: window.ui = window.gerard.battleUI; window.turn = id => document.querySelector('#battle .turn-meta')?.textContent === 'TU TURNO' && document.querySelector('.battle-dock[data-dock="1"]')?.dataset.member === id; ui.tweak(s => { s.foes.forEach(f => { f.hp = f.maxHp = 600; }); s.allies.forEach(a => { a.hp = Math.round(a.maxHp * .5); }); });

steps.caption: Matemágico's skills with their new names: Cardioide, Pirámide ígnea, Cubo acuático, Punto eléctrico, Integral impropia

steps.eval: { const b = document.querySelector('.party-card[data-unit="aitor"] .roster-target'); b ? b.click() : document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { code: 'Enter', key: 'Enter' })); }

steps.caption: Cardioide: a small circle rolls round another and its rim draws the cardioid in green; the curve comes apart from its cusp into motes that flow to Aitor, and the cure rises up him
Pirámide ígnea: a triangle drawn in fire, an apex pulls it into a pyramid that turns, flies over the dogs and blows up; the fire on each rises to the highest
Cubo acuático: a square drawn in water light, extruded into a cube that fills with water on its way to the middle of the dogs, swells and bursts over them: Mojado on all three
Punto eléctrico: a point of charge gathers in front of Gerard, rises crackling and falls on the dog as three jagged, forking strikes; Conducción runs to every wet dog
Integral impropia: ∫ from 0 to ∞ drawn upright, turned a quarter and laid between Gerard and Aitor; green light jets from both ends into each, and Sanación stays on them
After Integral impropia: Gerard and Aitor both carry Sanación, the cure on the clock
